break_mash.prompt: A wooden barrel of sour corn mash split open: a cracking stave, then a thick wet slosh pouring out onto the ground.

break_jugs.prompt: Three clay moonshine jugs shattering at once: crockery bursting, shards tinkling, liquor splashing.

break_jar.prompt: A big glass specimen jar bursting: a heavy glass pop and brine gushing and splattering on the floor.

break_cooler.prompt: A plastic picnic cooler shot open: hollow plastic crack, the lid clattering off, beer cans rolling out.

break_tin.prompt: Tin cans and a tin mailbox shot off a post: bright tinny clanks rattling down onto gravel.

break_flamingo.prompt: A plastic lawn flamingo shot and knocked over: one hollow plastic clack and a light bounce.

break_stuffing.prompt: A plush carnival prize bear burst by a shot: a soft fabric thump and a puff of stuffing and straw.

balloon_pop.prompt: A string of carnival balloons popping in a quick ragged run, four or five sharp pops.

alien_crate_break.prompt: An alien cargo pod bursting open: a buckling metal crunch and a wet rubbery squelch.

break_window.prompt: A dusty old storefront window shot out: a sharp crack, then big glass shards raining down and tinkling on boards.

break_fence.prompt: Weathered wooden fence boards blown out by a shotgun: splintering crack, boards snapping and clattering down.

sign_shot.prompt: A bullet smacking into a painted wooden sign: one sharp hollow wooden knock and a little rattle.

debris_settle.prompt: Small splinters, glass bits and scraps of tin landing and settling on the ground, a light scattered patter.

tnt_roll.prompt: A single stick of dynamite rolling across wooden boards: a light hollow papery roll and two small knocks.

body_thud.prompt: A limp body thrown down hard on dirt and boards: one heavy dull thud.

bowling_thud.prompt: A heavy bowling ball slamming into a wooden wall, then rumbling away across boards.

ricochet_tin.prompt: A bullet striking corrugated sheet tin: a thin bright metallic ping with a short buzz.

ricochet_whine.prompt: A bullet glancing off thick steel plate: a hard clank and a long whining ricochet flying off.

impact_brick.prompt: A bullet striking an old brick wall: a dry crack and a patter of grit and brick dust.

impact_glass.prompt: A bullet cracking a thick window pane without breaking it out: a sharp tick and a small glassy tinkle.

impact_brush.prompt: A bullet tearing through dry cornstalks and brush: a quick rustling thwip.

impact_mesh.prompt: A bullet striking a taut wire farm fence: a metallic twang that wobbles out.

impact_rubber.prompt: A bullet thumping into a stack of old car tyres: one dull rubbery thud.

pierce_plank.prompt: A rifle bullet punching clean through a plank wall: a splintering crack and wood chips spraying out the far side.

glass_settle.prompt: Small chips of broken window glass falling and settling on a wooden floor: a light tinkling scatter.

land_thump.prompt: A man in heavy work boots landing from a jump onto dirt: one solid boot thump with a little grunt of breath.

blow_grunt.prompt: A tough redneck man takes a light punch and grunts once, short and annoyed.

fuse_short.prompt: A short sharp fuse sizzle, a quick fizzing hiss that cuts off, just before something blows.

wade_splash.prompt: A man in boots stepping heavily into knee-deep swamp water: one big slosh and splash.

drip_small.prompt: A few single water drips falling into a still swamp puddle, quiet and close.

rain_loop.prompt: Steady moderate rain falling outdoors at night on dirt, puddles, tin roofs and parked truck hoods, no thunder.

rain_roof.prompt: Steady rain drumming on a tin roof heard from inside a wooden shed: a muffled close drumming, no thunder.

fire_crackle.prompt: A wood fire burning in a rusty steel burn barrel: crackles, pops and a soft roar, close.

ember_crackle.prompt: Embers and a small wood fire crackling softly, little pops and a faint hiss, close.

still_bubble.prompt: A copper moonshine still on a fire: low steady bubbling mash, dripping and the tick of hot copper.

generator_hum.prompt: A small gasoline generator running steadily: a putt-putting single-cylinder engine with a rattle.

core_thrum.prompt: A deep slow pulsing alien power core: a low throbbing thrum with a faint warbling shimmer on top.

airboat_wake.prompt: The hiss and slap of a fast boat's wake on swamp water: rushing water and spray, no engine.
